svt_mipi_dsi_monitor_callback Class Reference

Inheritance diagram for class svt_mipi_dsi_monitor_callback:

List of all members.

Detailed Description

Class that encapsulates MIPI DSI Monitor callback. This class defines Monitor callbacks that can be used by user. User can extend the class, add implementations to one or more of the callback methods.

  function void
 svt_mipi_dsi_monitor_callback::post_consume_lane_transaction_get
 (  svt_mipi_dsi_monitor monitor , int lane_id , svt_mipi_lane_transaction xact  ) 

Callback issued by monitor after pulling a transaction descriptor out of its input port, but before acting on the transaction descriptor in any way.

monitor - Reference to the svt_mipi_dsi_monitor that is issuing this callback. The user's callback implementation can use this to access the public data and/or methods of the driver.

lane_id - Numerical ID that identifies which input port was just accessed.

xact - Reference to the transaction descriptor object of interest.

  function void
 svt_mipi_dsi_monitor_callback::post_lane_transaction_get
 (  svt_mipi_dsi_monitor monitor , int lane_id , svt_mipi_lane_transaction xact , ref bit drop  ) 

Callback issued by driver after pulling a transaction descriptor out of its input port, but before acting on the transaction descriptor in any way.

monitor - Reference to the svt_mipi_dsi_monitor driver that is issuing this callback. The user's callback implementation can use this to access the public data and/or methods of the driver.

lane_id - Numerical ID that identifies which input port was just accessed.

xact - Reference to the transaction descriptor object of interest.

drop - A ref argument, which if set by the user's callback implementation causes the driver to discard the transaction descriptor without further action.
